svg.aria-label: MikroORM between your code and your database
svg.title: MikroORM between your code and your database
svg.desc: MikroORM, with its Identity Map and Unit of Work, sits in the middle. Your services, written with plain entity classes, call find, persist and flush on it, and the MikroORM CLI uses it for migrations and seeding. It connects to the database through one driver package per database: @mikro-orm/postgresql for PostgreSQL, @mikro-orm/mysql for MySQL and @mikro-orm/mongodb for MongoDB.
